must_fix.title: README contradicts the code: Tab-key row and the 'props go to the root element' claim
must_fix.evidence:
README Tabs keyboard table: '`Tab` | Moves focus out of the tablist to the selected tab.' A probe (userEvent.tab twice, then once more) shows Tab moves focus INTO the tablist to the selected tab and then OUT to the panel: 'TAB into: ' then 'TAB out:
pb
'. The README intro also says every component 'passes other native props to its root element', but src/Combobox.tsx spreads ...rest onto the (its wrapping
takes no props) and Dialog puts them on the role=dialog element, not the outermost backdrop element.

nits: Under <React.StrictMode> (development only), Dialog ignores a child with autoFocus: the probe focused <button>first</button> instead of <input autoFocus>, because StrictMode's cleanup moves focus back to the opener and the re-run focuses the first focusable element. Production builds are fine.
Tab arrow, Home and End handling also fires and calls preventDefault when Alt, Ctrl or Meta is held (Alt+ArrowRight moved to tab B, defaultPrevented).
The Combobox 'No results' <div> has no role=status or aria-live, so screen readers don't announce it.
Enter with typed text and no active option discards the text; Enter with the listbox closed submits an enclosing form. Matches the README but may surprise users.
Dialog FOCUSABLE selector leaves out [contenteditable], audio/video[controls] and summary.
Duplicate option values produce duplicate DOM ids.
Test names carry opaque spec prefixes (C1, D3, 'hostile:'), and tests/index.test.ts plus tests/raw.d.ts exist mainly to check the README text.

report:
Tests and typecheck pass and the components do what the issue asks. One small documentation fix is needed before merge. **Checks run** - `pnpm test`: 4 files and 79 tests, all passing. - `pnpm typecheck`: no errors. - No lint or format tooling and no changelog exist in the repo, so neither was checked. **Edge cases I tried** (in a temporary test file, deleted afterwards; `git status` is back to how I found it): - Tab key around the tablist. - Dialog `autoFocus` with and without ``. - Alt+Arrow on a tab. - Pressing Enter in a Combobox inside a `
`. - The "No results" markup. The existing tests already cover nested dialogs, a Combobox inside a Dialog with Escape, and tabs added, removed or disabled after mount, so I didn't repeat those. **Must fix: the README contradicts the code** - **Tab key row.** The README's Tabs keyboard table says Tab "Moves focus out of the tablist to the selected tab." My probe showed something different: Tab moves focus *into* the tablist, landing on the selected tab, and the next Tab leaves it for the panel: ``` TAB into: TAB out:
pb
``` - **"Root element" claim.** The README intro says "every component accepts `className` and passes other native props to its root element". That isn't true for two components: - `Combobox` spreads `...rest` onto the `` (`src/Combobox.tsx`); its wrapping `
` takes no props. - `Dialog` puts props on the `role="dialog"` element, not on the backdrop, which is the outermost element. The sections further down describe both correctly, so the intro needs to match them. **Nits** (worth raising, not blocking): - **Dialog `autoFocus` under StrictMode.** In development with ``, focus goes to the first focusable element instead of the `autoFocus` child. My probe got `` with StrictMode and `` without it. StrictMode's extra cleanup moves focus back to the opener, and the effect then picks the first focusable element. Production builds are fine. - **Arrow keys with modifiers on tabs.** The tab arrow handler still acts and calls `preventDefault` when Alt, Ctrl or Meta is held. Alt+ArrowRight moved to tab B and the browser's default was cancelled. - **"No results" isn't announced.** It's a plain `
` with no `role="status"` or `aria-live`, so screen readers won't read it. - **Enter discards typed text.** Pressing Enter with typed text and no active option throws the text away. This matches the README, but it could surprise users. - **Enter submits an enclosing form.** With the listbox closed, Enter in a Combobox inside a `` submits the form. That's arguably correct, but it isn't documented. - **Dialog focus list is incomplete.** `FOCUSABLE` leaves out `[contenteditable]`, `audio`/`video[controls]` and `summary`. - **Duplicate option values.** Two options with the same `value` produce duplicate DOM ids. - **Test names.** Test names use opaque prefixes ("C1", "D3", "hostile:"), and `tests/index.test.ts` exists mainly to check the README's text through a `?raw` import, which needs the extra `tests/raw.d.ts`.
